no-record.title: No fingerprint published
no-record.detail: This service publishes nothing yet. Retrieve the host keys from the server, or add a fingerprint by hand.

unknown-algorithm.title: Unknown key algorithm "{{algorithm}}"
unknown-algorithm.detail: Only RSA (1), DSA (2), ECDSA (3), Ed25519 (4) and Ed448 (6) are defined. A client will ignore anything else.

unknown-type.title: Unknown fingerprint type "{{type}}"
unknown-type.detail: Only SHA-1 (1) and SHA-256 (2) are defined for SSHFP records.

invalid-fingerprint.title: The fingerprint is not hexadecimal
invalid-fingerprint.detail: An SSHFP fingerprint is written as hexadecimal digits, with no colon and no space. The one ssh-keyscan prints in base64 has to be converted first.

fingerprint-length.title: A {{hash}} fingerprint should be {{expected}} characters long, not {{got}}
fingerprint-length.detail: The fingerprint does not match the declared type, so clients will refuse the connection as if the host key had changed.

sha1-only.title: The {{algorithm}} key is only published with SHA-1
sha1-only.detail: RFC 6594 asks for a SHA-256 fingerprint. Publish it next to the SHA-1 one, which older clients still read.

dsa-deprecated.title: DSA keys are obsolete
dsa-deprecated.detail: OpenSSH disabled DSA by default years ago and has since removed it. Publish an Ed25519 or an ECDSA key instead.

duplicate.title: Duplicate fingerprint
duplicate.detail: The same algorithm, type and fingerprint appear more than once. Keep only one record.

owner-is-cname.title: "{{subdomain}}" is an alias
owner-is-cname.detail: A CNAME cannot coexist with the SSHFP records of its name (RFC 1034 sec. 3.6.2). Publish the fingerprints on the name the alias points to.

no-address.title: "{{subdomain}}" has no A/AAAA in this zone
no-address.detail: An SSHFP is only ever looked up for a name a user connects to. Add a Server entry for this name, or move the fingerprints to the name of the machine.

retrieve.description: Read the host keys straight from the server, instead of copying the fingerprints by hand.
retrieve.nothing-new: Every fingerprint the server offers is already published here.

status.blocked: This happyDomain instance is not allowed to reach that address.
status.connect-error: The SSH server could not be reached.
status.handshake-error: The server answered, but not as an SSH server.
status.timeout: The SSH server did not answer in time.

SSHFPs.name: SSHFP
SSHFPs.description: Store SSH key fingerprints in DNS.
